Shared chase-spring integrator — a damped spring
Sourcesrc/core\utils\motion\spring.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

(module scope)

Minimal chase-spring state — the field names are the contract the widget classes already carry (currentP/targetP + velP).

currentP

Current position (track units).

velP

Spring velocity (track units per second).

targetP

Chase target (track units).

springStep

Advances one integration step: accelerates toward targetP under stiffness k and damping c, then snaps to the stop once both the gap and the velocity fall under the settle epsilons — without the snap an underdamped spring rings sub-pixel forever.

  • @param s The chase state — mutated in place (zero allocation).
  • @param k Spring stiffness (ωn²).
  • @param c Spring damping (2ζωn).
  • @param dt Integration step in seconds (clamped upstream).
  • @param epsSettle Settle epsilon in the state's units — the slider
  • @param epsVel Velocity settle epsilon (state units/s) — see epsSettle.
